Estimated Cost and Contract Period The estimated cost of the Comprehensive Maintenance & Operation contract is₹ 20,55,79 6/- (Rupees Twenty Lakh Fifty-Five Thousand Seven Hundred and Ninety-Six only ) for a period of Two (2) years. The contract shall commence from the date of issue of the Work Order. 2. Eligibility Criteria 2.1 OEM Authorization The bidder shall submit a valid OEM Authorization Letter along with the bid for the follo wing equipment: 1.Full Height Dual Lane Turnstile 2.Face Reader Unit 3.RFID Smart Card Reader-cum-Controller

4.Access Control and Time Attendance System Software The OEM Authorization Letter shall authorize the bidder to undertake operation, maintenan ce, servicing, repair and comprehensive maintenance of the above systems. Failure to submit the required OEM Authorization Letter may render the bid liable for rejecti on, subject to applicable GeM provisions. 2.2 Past Experience of Similar Services Similar services shall mean: Supply/Installation/AMC/Operation of Access Control Systems/Electronic Security Systems/CCTV systems. The bidder shall submit relevant Work Orders/Contracts and Completion Certificates/ Performance Certificates as documentary evidence. 3. Project Data The Fast Reactor Fuel Cycle Facility (FRFCF) Plant Site is located at Kalpakkam, appro ximately 85 km from Chennai. The site is accessible by road from Chennai through Chengal pattu/Thirukkazhukundram and through Mamallapuram. The contractor shall consider the c limatic and environmental conditions prevailing at the site, including high humidity, salt-lad en atmosphere and high ambient temperature, which may contribute to corrosion, rust and fungal growth. Parameter Details Ambient Temperature Up to 40°C Installation Indoor/Outdoor Power Supply 415V, 3 Phase, 4 Wire, 50 Hz Power Supply 240V, 1 Phase, 50 Hz The bidder shall satisfy itself regarding site conditions, accessibility, existing system conditi on and other factors affecting execution of the contract before submitting the bid. 4. Duration of Contract The Comprehensive Maintenance & Operation contract shall be valid for a period ofT wo (2 ) years from the date of issue of the Work Order. 5. Termination of Contract

Although the contract is intended to remain valid for two years, the Department reserves the right to terminate the contract by giving one month's notice, without assigning any r eason and without any financial liability beyond payment for services satisfactorily rendere d up to the date of termination. Payment for services rendered shall be made on a pro-rata basis. Any excess payment made to the contractor shall be refunded to the Department. Th e Department may extend the contract period, if required, subject to applicable rules and mutually agreed terms. 6. Performance Security The contractor shall submit Performance Security equivalent to 3% of the total cont ract value. The Performance Security shall remain valid for3 0 months. The Performance Security shal l be submitted in the prescribed form as specified in the tender/GeM contract. 7. Facilities at Site Covered Storage area will be made available to the Contractor for storage of these material s and equipment before and during execution. The contractor shall be responsible for loadi ng/unloading, handling and transporting of all the materials including tools to the actual sit e of work. The contractor shall make his own arrangement for the boarding and lodging of t he personnel to be employed in this contractor. No housing, medical and transport facilities will be provided by the department. 8. Power Supply and Intercom Facility A single-phase supply of 230V ±10%, 50 Hz ±3% may be provided at one designated poi nt free of cost for maintenance-related activities. The Department may provide an intercom facility for receiving complaints from users. No landline or mobile phone facility shall be provided by the Department. Use of mobile phones/electronic devices inside the FRFCF Project Site shall be governed by the prevailing security regulations and permissions of FRFCF. 9. Backup of System Data Necessary backups on employee details with card entries, card details have to be taken per iodically at least once in thirty days. The service engineer should keep backups and also sh ould submit a copy in the soft-format to the EIC. The supply of Hard disk required for keepi ng backups also includes in scope of work. Hard disk shall be USB powered, 1TB capacity a nd preferred make: Transcend/Sony/HP/Seagate. The contractor shall provide a USB-powe red 1 TB external hard disk for backup purposes. Preferred makes are Transcend/Sony/HP/Seagate or equivalent, subject to approval. No backup data or storage device shall be removed from the Project Site without prior auth orization.

10. Specific Terms and Conditions 10.1 Pre-Commencement Inspection Before commencement of the Comprehensive Maintenance & Operation work, the contract or shall inspect all systems/equipment covered under the contract and submit a detailed Pr e-Commencement Condition Report to the EIC. The existing condition/status of the syst ems shall be jointly recorded. 10.2 OEM Authorization The bidder shall submit valid OEM Authorization Letters for the equipment’s. 10.3 Engineer-in-Charge An Engineer-in-Charge (EIC) shall be nominated by the Project Director, FRFCF for overal l coordination and smooth execution of the contract. All service reports, preventive mainte nance reports and bills shall be submitted to the EIC for verification and certification. 10.4 Equipment Taken for Service Any equipment taken by the contractor for servicing shall be returned after servicing with c omplete configuration and accessories. 10.5 Hard Disk Formatting If formatting of any hard disk is required during maintenance, prior permission shall be obt ained from the User and Coordinator. The contractor shall be responsible for backup and re storation of data. No hard disk, memory device or storage device shall be taken outside the Project Site without prior written permission. 10.6 Transportation of Equipment The contractor shall be responsible for carrying/returning original equipment for servicing, bringing substitute equipment wherever required and all associated transportation expens es. 10.7 Firm and Fixed Rates The Comprehensive Maintenance & Operation charges quoted shall remain firm and fixed throughout the contract period. No escalation or additional charges shall be admissible . 10.8 Office Space Office/work space with intercom facility may be provided within the campus for maintenanc e purposes, subject to availability. No residential accommodation, transportation or medical facilities shall be provided.

10.9 Contract Number The Work Order/Contract Number shall be quoted in all correspondence, service reports an d bills. 10.10 No Additional Charges No additional payment shall be made towards transportation, boarding, lodging or other ex penses of service personnel visiting the site. 10.11 Authorized Personnel The systems/equipment shall be accessed only by the contractor's authorized and security- cleared personnel. 10.12 No Sub-Contracting The work shall be executed by the successful bidder through its own authorized personnel. Sub-contracting or assignment of the work to any third party shall not be permitted without prior written approval of the Department. 10.13 Site Familiarization The contractor is to get acquainted with the site conditions, approach, availability of materi als, camping facilities for his work force, geological and weather conditions and all other rel evant information required for tendering before quoting. Further the successful bidder is a dvised to ascertain the condition/status of the systems available at the site before signing t he Contract Agreement. 11. Security Requirements The work site is a restricted area and you shall have to comply with all the Rules and Regul ations made by the department regarding entry, conduct and exit of personnel, vehicles, m aterials and other matters related to secrecy and security. Prior permission of the coordina tor and department is to be taken well in advance, for working at plant site beyond normal hours and to work on holidays. Security procedure should be followed as per the order of t he FRFCF Security from time to time. The contractor may be allowed to work beyond norma l working hours only with prior approval of the Competent Authority. 12. Personnel Entry and Material Control Each employee/worker shall furnish the required photographs, police verification certificate and other documents required for obtaining entry passes. No person shall be permitted to enter the plant site without a valid photo pass. All machinery, materials, tools, tackles and consumables brought into the plant site shall b e declared to Security through the prescribed material list. Only items duly recorded and endorsed by Security shall be permitted to be removed from the plant site through the prescribed gate-pass procedure.

13. Safety and Housekeeping The contractor shall be responsible for implementation of all applicable safety precautions during execution of the work. All work areas shall be maintained in a safe, clean and tidy condition. The contractor shall protect all existing equipment, systems, materials and facilities from d amage. All instructions issued by the Coordinator/EIC/Safety Officer shall be strictly followed. Any work found to violate safety requirements shall be stopped immediately. Prior clearance shall be obtained before carrying out work on installed systems. 14. Confidentiality and Secrecy The contractor shall maintain strict confidentiality regarding all information, documents, sy stem configurations, software, data, drawings, records and other information obtained duri ng execution of the contract. No information relating to FRFCF or the systems shall be disclosed to any third party withou t prior written permission. The contractor shall ensure that all its employees, engineers, consultants and other person nel comply with these requirements. Photography, video recording or audio/video documentation of the plant, work site, system s or equipment shall not be permitted without prior approval of the Competent Authority. The contractor shall not use the name or details of FRFCF for publicity, advertisement or pr omotional purposes without prior written approval. 15. Preventive Maintenance The contractor shall carry out preventive maintenance of all equipment and systems cover ed under the Comprehensive Maintenance & Operation contract as per the following sched ule: "The Contractor shall deploy a qualified Service Engineer at the site on all workin g days from 9am to 5.30pm. The Service Engineer shall be responsible for key du ties, e.g., preventive maintenance, fault resolution, and daily reporting. In the ev ent of planned or unplanned absence, the Contractor shall provide a suitable repl acement with prior notice to Engineer-in-Charge. Failure to maintain on-site cove rage may result in specify deduction/penalty in accordance with the contract ter ms." Frequency Primary Check Action taken & Follow-up

Quarterly Preventive Maintenance Report; 2. Equipment-wise Preventive Maintenance Checklist; 3. Operational Test Report; 4. Service Call Register; 5. Complaint and rectification details; 6. Details of pending complaints, if any; 7. User satisfaction/acknowledgement, wherever applicable; and 8. EIC certification. The quarterly preventive maintenance report shall be signed by the concerned user/service personnel and certified by the EIC. Quarterly payment shall be released only after satisfactory completion of the pre ventive maintenance activities and submission of the required reports duly certif ied by the EIC. 16. Fault Severity Levels and Restoration Time Any fault/failure shall be intimated to the designated Service Engineer/Resident Engineer th rough phone, mobile, email or other approved communication mode. The contractor shall immediately inform the concerned service centre/technical team and i nitiate corrective action.

16.1 Severity Level–1 – Complete Main System/Server Failure In case of complete failure of the Main System/Server, the failure shall be classified asS ev erity Level–1. The contractor shall attend the complaint immediately andr estore/rectify the system w ithin 72 hours from the time of intimation. 16.2 Severity Level–2 – Partial Main/Remote System Failure Failure of more than one card reader or face station affecting 50% or more of the servic e, or failure of Item Nos. 6 to 8, shall be classified asS everity Level–2. The contractor shall attend the complaint immediately andr estore/rectify the system w ithin 48 hours from the time of intimation. 16.3 Severity Level–3 – Individual/Partial System Failure Failure affecting up to 25% of the service, including failure of Item Nos. 1 to 5 shall be cla ssified as Severity Level–3. The contractor shall attend the complaint immediately andr estore/rectify the system w ithin 24 hours from the time of intimation. 17. Penalty for Delay in Repair/Restoration If any system is not repaired/restored within the stipulated Guaranteed Repair/Restoration Time and an equivalent system is also not provided within the stipulated time, a penalty, as decided by the Competent Authority, may be imposed. The penalty under this clause shall be limited to a maximum of 10% of the total contr act value. In addition to the above penalty, FRFCF reserves the right to get the system repaired/servic ed through an external agency at the risk and cost of the contractor. The expenditure incurred for such repair/service shall be recoverable from the contractor in addition to the applicable penalty. 18. Recoveries The Department shall have the right to recover from payments due to the contractor any a mount payable by the contractor under the contract, including: Penalties/Liquidated Damages; Cost of repair/replacement of equipment damaged due to contractor's negligence; Cost incurred for external agency services; Statutory deductions; and Any other recoverable amount under the contract. 19. Payment Terms The contractor shall submit quarterly invoices in the format approved by the EIC/Accounts Section, FRFCF, NRB.

Payment shall be made at the end of each quarter after satisfactory execution of the servic es and submission of the required preventive maintenance and service reports. For a two-year contract comprising eight quarters, payment shall be made on a pro-rata ba sis, subject to a maximum of 12.5% of the total contract value for each completed q uarter. Equipment-wise Maintenance Checklist; 4. Daily/Weekly/Monthly maintenance records, as applicable; 5. Service Call Register; 6. Complaint/Rectification Report; 7. Operational Test Report; 8. User satisfaction/acknowledgement, wherever applicable; 9. EIC certification; and Details of pending complaints. 21. Completion Report and Final Payment The final payment shall be released only after submission of aC ompletion Report duly ce rtified by the EIC confirming that: All equipment/systems have been serviced and maintained as per the contract; All complaints have been satisfactorily resolved; All systems are in satisfactory working condition; All FRFCF equipment/materials held by the contractor have been returned; All required reports/documents have been submitted; and No recoverable amount or contractual obligation remains pending.
